_note: Draft by Claude, levels 1-2 only. Jerry to review. Only nouns, verbs and adjectives for now, because /data/structures.json has templates only for those. frequency_rank is an estimate, not from a corpus. Field guide: gender is 'm', 'f', or 'm/f' (a person noun with both forms, one word: show as 'ami / amie'). feminine + article_f give the feminine form (nouns with m/f, and every adjective; same spelling when it doesn't change). example_f is the example for a female learner, only where 'je' needs agreement; otherwise use example for everyone. note is a short tip for the word card (e.g. why a verb has 'se'). other_meanings lists other common meanings of the same French word: word_id links to that meaning's own entry, or null when it is an N.B. only; nb is the reminder shown to the learner.
